prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A small square shutter of rough pitch-black timber swings open from the inside, grey daylight spilling in on a family in silhouette seen from behind, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot. Grey morning. Expectant. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
